sections.title: Mastery check
sections.directions: Unit assessment. Work alone, show your steps, and check your work before you finish.

items.prompt: Compare a sphere of radius r and a cylinder of radius r and height 2r with two cones removed. What does Cavalieri’s principle tell us?
choices: Nothing, because Cavalieri’s principle applies only to prisms.
They have equal volumes, because every horizontal cross-section has the same area at the same height.
They have equal volumes, and matching cross-sections is exactly how the sphere volume formula is derived.
The cone has one third the volume, which Cavalieri’s principle establishes by comparing cross-sections against a reference solid.
